templates.name: Chest and Triceps Strength
templates.description: Heavy barbell pressing with focused triceps work for a standard gym session.

exercises.instructions: Keep shoulder blades pinched and feet planted.
Lower to the upper chest under control.
Lean slightly forward to bias the chest.
Keep upper arms still and lower toward the forehead.
Pin elbows to your sides and fully extend.

templates.name: Chest and Triceps Dumbbell Builder
templates.description: Dumbbell and bench volume session for chest and triceps size.

exercises.instructions: Press up and slightly together over the chest.
Open the arms wide with a soft elbow bend.
Stop two reps before form breaks down.
Keep elbows pointing forward.

templates.name: Chest and Triceps Bodyweight Express
templates.description: A short no-machine session using push-ups, dips and a chest stretch.

exercises.instructions: Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Use a controlled lowering phase.
Brace the abs and squeeze the glutes.
Ease into the stretch without pain.

templates.name: Back and Biceps Strength
templates.description: Heavy rows and pull-ups followed by barbell curls and rear delt work.

exercises.instructions: Hinge to a flat back and row to the lower ribs.
Start each rep from a full hang.
Pull toward the face with elbows high.
Do not swing the torso.

templates.name: Back and Biceps Dumbbell Builder
templates.description: Dumbbell-only back and arm session, with a Romanian deadlift to cover the lower back.

exercises.instructions: Drive the elbow toward the hip.
Keep the dumbbells close to the legs.
Pause briefly at the top.
Keep the wrists neutral.

templates.name: Back and Biceps Machine Starter
templates.description: A short guided session on machines and cables for newer lifters.

exercises.instructions: Pull the bar to the upper chest.
Choose assistance that lets you finish every rep.
Keep elbows fixed at your sides.

templates.name: Legs Strength Long Session
templates.description: Long squat and hinge session with posterior chain and calf finishers.

exercises.instructions: Brace before each descent.
Push the hips back and keep a flat back.
Pause at full hip extension.
Pause at the stretch and the top.

templates.name: Legs Dumbbell Builder
templates.description: Unilateral and squat-pattern leg volume using dumbbells and a bench.

exercises.instructions: Keep the chest tall at the bottom.
Do all reps on one leg before switching.
Take long controlled steps.
Drive through the front heel.

templates.name: Legs Bodyweight Endurance
templates.description: A 30-minute equipment-free leg circuit with a finishing stretch.

exercises.instructions: Sit between the hips with heels down.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.
Keep thighs parallel to the floor.
Tuck the pelvis under to feel the stretch.

templates.name: Upper Body Strength
templates.description: Compound press and pull pairing for a standard heavy upper day.

exercises.instructions: Squeeze the glutes and keep ribs down.

templates.name: Upper Body Dumbbell Builder
templates.description: Dumbbell press, row and arm work with a bench.

exercises.instructions: Press without arching the lower back.
Lead with the elbows and stop at shoulder height.

templates.name: Upper Body Bodyweight Endurance
templates.description: Short pull-up bar and dip bar circuit for upper body stamina.

exercises.instructions: Pull the chest toward the bar.
Keep shoulders active, not shrugged.

templates.name: Lower Body Machine Starter
templates.description: Guided machine session covering quads, hamstrings, hips and calves.

exercises.instructions: Do not lock the knees at the top.

templates.name: Lower Body Hinge and Squat Strength
templates.description: Heavy trap bar and front squat work with glute and hamstring support.

exercises.instructions: Push the floor away and keep the bar close.
Keep elbows high through the lift.

templates.name: Lower Body Bodyweight and Mobility
templates.description: A short bodyweight strength and stretching session for hips and legs.

exercises.instructions: Move slowly and breathe through each position.
Back off if you feel knee pain.

templates.name: Push Day Strength
templates.description: Barbell and dip pressing session with shoulder and triceps accessories.

exercises.instructions: Squeeze the hands together at the front.

templates.name: Push Day Machine and Cable Builder
templates.description: Stable machine and cable push session for volume with low setup effort.

templates.name: Push Day Dumbbell Short
templates.description: A 30-minute dumbbell and push-up session.

templates.name: Pull Day Strength
templates.description: Deadlift-led pull session with rows, pull-ups and rear delt support.

exercises.instructions: Set the back flat before the bar leaves the floor.

templates.name: Pull Day Cable and Machine Builder
templates.description: Cable and machine pull volume with arms and rear delts.

templates.name: Pull Day Bodyweight Endurance
templates.description: Low-equipment pulling session using a bar and rack for beginners.

exercises.instructions: Pick a band that lets you finish every rep.
Keep the body in a straight line.
Move slowly with your breath.

templates.name: Full Body Strength
templates.description: Classic barbell full body session built on squat, press, row and hinge.

templates.name: Full Body Conditioning Short
templates.description: A 30-minute kettlebell and dumbbell circuit with a loaded carry.

exercises.instructions: Snap the hips; the arms only guide.
Walk tall and do not let the shoulders round.

templates.name: Full Body Bodyweight Starter
templates.description: Equipment-free beginner session covering legs, push and core.

exercises.instructions: Use a raised hand position if needed.

templates.name: Arms Gym Hypertrophy
templates.description: Dedicated biceps and triceps volume using the gym's bars and cables.

templates.name: Arms Dumbbell Short
templates.description: Quick dumbbell arm session with a loaded carry for grip.

templates.name: Arms Strength
templates.description: Lower-rep barbell curls and dips with chin-ups for heavy arm work.

templates.name: Shoulders and Core Strength
templates.description: Overhead pressing and delt work followed by loaded core exercises.

exercises.instructions: Curl the pelvis up instead of swinging.
Resist rotation as you press out.

templates.name: Shoulders and Core Dumbbell
templates.description: Dumbbell shoulder session with plank variations.

exercises.instructions: Do both sides each set.

templates.name: Core Bodyweight Endurance
templates.description: Short equipment-free core circuit (no shoulder-specific exercises exist in the library).

exercises.instructions: Do both sides each set.
Stay short of lower-back arching.
